claims.claim: Sells engine, suspension and body parts for all Acura and Honda cars and SUVs
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only one bumper; the seller's broader inventory is not shown.
Photo 0 cannot establish whether the part is new or used.
No photo or document shows country of origin.
Static photos of a body part cannot show testing or function.
Engine noise claim is not applicable to or visible in photos of a bumper.
Mileage cannot be determined from photos of a body panel.
Not applicable to or visible on a body part in photos.

claims.claim: Fits all Acura and Honda models
claims.evidence: No model number, brand plate, or fitment information is visible on the part.

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, scratches, dents, or repairs on the bumper.
risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of the entire part from all angles, especially edges, mounting holes, and the central opening.
risks.if_unproven: priced as damaged or poor condition.

risks.risk: Exact vehicle fitment (make, model, year) is unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of any molded part number, OEM label, or the part fitted on the specific vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown fitment, may not fit the buyer's car.

risks.risk: Genuine OEM versus aftermarket cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo showing Honda or Acura OEM branding, part number, or original packaging.
risks.if_unproven: priced as aftermarket or unknown origin.

risks.risk: Mounting hardware, clips, or brackets may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included fasteners and clips next to the part.
risks.if_unproven: priced as part only, without hardware.

risks.risk: The part may not be Tokunbo or imported as claimed.
risks.proof: Close-up showing wear consistent with import/use, or shipping documents.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used or local condition.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the bumper from front, back, and sides showing any cracks or repairs.
Photo of any part number, brand stamp, or OEM label on the bumper.
Photo of all mounting clips and hardware included with the part.
Video showing the part's condition around mounting points and edges.
response.reason: The witness identified the item as a car bumper, so a worst-case price can be set despite unknown condition, fitment, and origin.
